title: Lost Sub-Frames by Cause
dataSources: Observing sessions (`astronomy:session`), sky quality (`skyquality:reading`), mount telemetry (`mount:session`), focus metrics (`focus:metric`), observatory roof state (`observatory:roof`), sub-frame results (`astroimage:sub`), and all-sky detections (`allsky:event`).
app: Astronomy telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, Sky Quality Meters, all-sky cameras, focus routines, roof controllers, and image-rejection logs streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=astroimage:sub
| stats count as subs by reject_reason
| sort - subs
description: Counts rejected sub-frames by reason so clouds, guiding errors, dew, and focus problems are easier to prioritize.
value: Rejected frames are lost time, and breaking them down by cause points directly at the next improvement to make.
implementation: Log every accepted and rejected sub-frame with a normalized rejection reason from your stacking or capture pipeline.
visualization: Bar chart of rejected sub-frame count by reason.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights why your astrophotography frames are getting thrown away, so you know what to fix first.
